analysis.reason: RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간에서 횡보 중. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간. ADX 30.4로 추세 강도는 양호하나, 거래량비 0.48로 거래량은 위축. 5일 연속 관망 유지하며 추세 전환 신호 대기.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold and is consolidating in neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. ADX at 30.4 indicates good trend strength, but volume ratio of 0.48 shows contraction. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 5 consecutive days, awaiting trend reversal signals.
analysis.narrative:
[추세 위치]
· 현재가(1,346,000원) vs SMA5(1,283,000원)/SMA20(1,503,800원)/SMA50(1,629,102원): 단기 SMA5 상회, 중단기 SMA20/50 하회하며 횡보 구간 진단

[모멘텀 지표]

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-60141.6135→-16199.5538): 음수 구간에서 개선 중이나 약세 전환 신호 미확인
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 1,503,800원): 중단 부근 횡보하며 방향성 부재
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 (1,246,000원): 50일 이동평균선 및 20일 볼린저밴드 하단 지지 기반
· 스윙 저항선 (1,890,000원): 50일 볼린저밴드 상단 및 200일 이동평균선 저항 구간
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보): 5일 고가 1,381,000원, 5일 저가 1,171,000원, 20일 고가 1,855,000원, 20일 저가 1,171,000원 범위 내 움직임
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.48배): 5일 평균 대비 거래량 위축, 움직임 신뢰도 하락
· 현 구간 진단 (축적 구간): RSI 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 횡보, 거래량 위축으로 추세 전환 신호 대기하며 관망 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,346,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,283,000 KRW) / SMA20 (1,503,800 KRW) / SMA50 (1,629,102 KRW): Diagnosing a sideways range with short-term SMA5 break above, while mid-term SMA20/50 remain above.
· Position relative to SMA100 (1,858,804 KRW) / SMA200 (1,480,327 KRW): Attempting recovery after breaking below mid-to-long-term trend lines.
· 52-week position (34.0%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (24.6→39.5): Exited oversold territory and continuing in neutral zone, indicating weakening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-60141.6135→-16199.5538): Improving within negative territory, but no bearish reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 1,503,800 KRW): Sideways movement around the middle band, showing lack of directional conviction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (1,246,000 KRW): Based on 50-day Moving Average and 20-day Bollinger Band lower boundary support.
· Swing Resistance (1,890,000 KRW): Resistance zone at the 50-day Bollinger Band upper boundary and 200-day Moving Average.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways): Movement within the range of 5-day high 1,381,000 KRW, 5-day low 1,171,000 KRW, 20-day high 1,855,000 KRW, 20-day low 1,171,000 KRW.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.48x): Volume contraction compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): RSI exited oversold and is consolidating in neutral zone; with contracted volume, awaiting trend reversal signals and maintaining a watch-and-see approach.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 5일/20일 고가/저가 범위 내 횡보 구간, 명확한 추세 패턴 부재.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 4 consecutive trading days. Today's RSI rise from 24.6 to 39.5 and MACD histogram improvement from -60141.6135 to -16199.5538 led to an upward adjustment of the buy score from 4 to 5; however, entry for purchase is withheld due to volume contraction.
